content: An'lɔɔŋ ntɔn ngyamàkà
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl muyamà kà ikal mwɛy. Umpal kàmay nde, un'lɔŋki ande mwɛy kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, ilɔŋ muyamà asànaa Ywan kàlɔŋ nde alɔŋki ande. »
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mpal làyamà bɛ, làtɛn abà: "Taa! Wɛy ikɔb angye ikäl kyà in'kyɛɛl, wɛy imwol angye iyi.
Ipɛ ŋàbà isaa abi byà ilä a ilä.
Idwääl nkul asànaa ifàdwääl bi nkul akà baar bàfikyer ube. Twon an'pà mbwo naa bi ibilà u ndɛb." »
Nde waa kàfàtɛn a ba naa: « Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ we anà un'sam, waa nde ukyen akà nde uboboo a mpib ntɔn mulɔm akà nde naa. "Un'sam, nsɔɔm nsɔ tär,
ntɔn un'sam amɛ mwɛy kan'fà kwɛl, kan'yàkɔlà apanà u ndwà amɛ, wɛɛ mɛ undiir un'pà watɛy."
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa uboo a ndwà ande un'sam ande awun kan'fuur naa: "Twon aman'sà lingyoomà, ibeenà kyàŋàbäm, baan amɛ anà mɛ ŋakwo ibaŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, mɛ in'fàsubà anki ntɔn mupà ngye nsɔ."
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa nde usubà anki mukun'pà ya ntɔn nde wà un'sam ande, nde akyer ayàsubà mukun'pà undiir wanswà awe nde awà mfun ntɔn un'sam ande wàmusà muküünà.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: Làlɔ̈m, waa bàlapà. Làleŋ, waa bɛ làyàman. Làbɛɛrà, waa bàyàladuub.
Ntɔn mbuur wanswà afàlɔm akyer afàwal, mbuur afàleŋ akyer afàman, anà bàfàduub akà mbuur afàbɛɛrà.
Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ wà taa, nkye nde kan'kwo mupà mwan ande ntäy isàkal naa nde kàmulɔ̈ɔ̈m nsö?
Itàkal naa nde kan'lɔm kyà, waa nde kun'pà lànye?
Isàkal naa bɛ baar abe làkyàyöb mupà baan abɛ indiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ Taa u du waa mpa upà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl akà baar bàmulɔ̈ɔ̈m? »
Nkye Yɛsu wà un'syääl a Bɛlzebul?
Yàlɔ̈m naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàböŋ unsɔŋà mwɛy kàbuulà mbuur mwɛy nkiin. Ungö a ntoo a unsɔŋà awun, nkiin waa kàsɛmà musà ndaa, baar banswà bàkäl unsà ubem.
Wɛɛ baar bumwɛy uboo a ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nde ayisyääl ikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul, mfum a insɔŋà, ntɔn muböŋ insɔŋà. »
Baar bumwɛy waa bàlɔ̈m naa nde ukyer impà kyan'fà du ntɔn mukun'si.
Yɛsu abà kàyöb nde an'kyän aba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Imwol kyanswà kye anà nkaabà uboo a kya, kya ikyer afàpää: Ndwà ibwà udu a ndwà yumwɛy.
Isàkal naa Satanà wà un'yiiŋ ande ŋakwo, imwol ande iyàtsim aben? Ntɔn bɛ làtɛɛnà naa mɛ in'kaböŋà insɔŋà kà ikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul.
Isàkal naa mɛ insɔŋà in'kaböŋà kikɔ̈b a Bɛlzebul, baan abɛ insɔŋà bàfàböŋ kà ikɔ̈b a nà? Lalan ba ŋakwo bàsàkal atsüül a nsaŋ abɛ.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mɛ insɔŋà in'yiböŋ a làpin a Nzam, iswaŋà naa imwol a Nzam kyàkyàtol akà bɛ.
Uman naa mbuur a ngwal awe anà an'tà màŋàkwo wàmuler ndwà ande, indiir ande mbuur uyàba anki.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur asin kàmun'söön u ngwal kan'yà, kan'wal iböŋ udu ande, nde kun'gyɔɔr an'tà ande manswà kàsyee nde làkyän, waa ukab indiir byanswà kàmun'gyɔɔr nde.
« Mbuur mpa awà anà mɛ nde wà un'yiiŋ amɛ, wɛɛ mbuur mpa ayàtüüb anà mɛ ntɔn muböbà, nde wàmupay.
Mfurà a dweelà a làbe
« Isàkal naa dweelà a làbe lan'too uboo a mbuur, la làfàkyà nsye a ipɔl muleŋ ikal akàyöör. La usàkɔɔn aman ikal ayöör laa làtɛn la naa: "Mɛ in'furà ndwà amɛ kàfü mɛ."
Mpal làyàfurà la, la làsàman ya yàŋàkɔɔm, indiir byanswà byàŋayöŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ,
laa ukyà nde, ukàwal nde an'dweelà nsambwaar mà mun'söön u nkyɛl, ma màbilà u ndwà, waa màbwaay. Apan mpay a mbuur awà laa isöönà ya mpay yàtàtwɛb. »
Ubwaŋ aŋàkwo
Yàmɛnà naa mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutɛɛnà abwɛy, un'kaar mwɛy kàmbarà uboo a baar, waa kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: « Un'sak akà un'kaar kakäär kà an'bäl ande anà kanüü an'bɛɛl ande! »
Nde waa kàfuur naa: « Aay, un'sak aŋasöönà akà baar bàweemà ndaa a Nzam anà bàsyäälà ya. »
Baar ban'lɔm idiim
Umpal ban'yàköŋ baar apà Yɛsu, nde kàsɛmà mutɛn naa: « Baar a mpalàbà bà baar abe: ba bàlɔɔmà idiim, wɛɛ ba idiim asin bàman anki, idiim nsil kyà Yɔnas.
Lalan, asànaa Yɔnas kàkäl nde idiim ntɔn baar a Ninive, abun sye Mwan a mbuur uyàkal nde idiim ntɔn baar a mpalàbà.

Kà ilä a nsaŋ, mfum a ngyɛl wà un'kaar akyer asàmbarà kusà a baar a mpalàbà ntɔn mukapà ikwàndwà, ntɔn nde kàfü ntsü a kwɛl muyàwem an'yeerà a Salɔmun. Wɛɛ apà we anà mbuur kan'söön Salɔmun.

Kà ilä a nsaŋ, baar a Ninive bàkyer asàmbarà kusà a baar a mpalàbà ntɔn mukapà ikwàndwà, ntɔn baar a Ninive bàbuul mpem umpal bàwem ba an'lɔɔŋ a Yɔnas. Wɛɛ apà we anà mbuur kan'söön Yɔnas!
Mwinà a ndür
« Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukyä mwinà waa nde uyee wa, itàkal naa nde usi wa u ngyɛl a kantin. Wɛɛ nde wa asà udu a un'te bàfàsà mwinà ntɔn baar bàbilà u ndwà bàmɛn pɛɛlà.
Mii angye myà mwinà a ndür angye: isàkal naa mii angye myà ubwaŋ, ndür angye yanswà ikal uboo a pɛɛlà, wɛɛ mii angye isàkal anà ukyal, ndür angye yanswà ikal uboo a làpib.
Duub mii angye ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛy pɛɛlà a ndür angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà làpib.
Abun, isàkal naa ndür angye yanswà yà uboo a pɛɛlà, akà ikal mwɛy kyatɛy uboo a làpib, ya yanswà iyàkal uboo a pɛɛlà, asànaa mwinà ufàpà wa ngye ŋakwo pɛɛlà a in'ŋyäŋ ande. »
Yɛsu kan'pà ikwàndwà akà Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn
Yàmɛnà naa mpal kàmay Yɛsu mutɛn, umfarisi mwɛy kun'bel ntɔn mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Yɛsu kàbilà nde, waa kàbwaay u mɛsà.
Umfarisi awun kàkyer abem muman naa Yɛsu kàtàywab anki kusà mudyà.
Wɛɛ Mwol waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Le ndaa abɛ Amfarisi: Bɛ làfàsɔŋ nsà a an'kɔɔb anà an'lɔŋà, wɛɛ uboo bɛ làbà aŋàyɔl a làmfɛɛl anà nkyɛl mbɔɔn.
Angwöy Mbuur akwà kàkyer nsà, nde boo kàkyer anki?
Làpɛ akà aŋàlàmbwà indiir abyà uboo a an'kɔɔb anà uboo a an'lɔŋà abɛ, waa indiir byanswà byàyàkal byà in'kyɛɛl ntɔn bɛ.

« Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà bɛ Amfarisi! Bɛ làfàpà mwɛy uboo a kwem wà nkay ifàsà indiir ntsà asànaa un'dül anà köb anà nkay adyà asin yà ifà ifà, wɛɛ bɛ làfàkyer anki ndaa a balàbal anà ukwen a Nzam: undiir làlàkyer bɛ ukɔɔn adiimà indiir byumwɛy.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ Amfarisi, ntɔn bɛ làfàkwen an'kir a làkoo u ndwà a nköŋ. Bɛ làfàkwen naa baar bàlapɛ mbɔr kà ikal a nköŋ.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ! Bɛ làbà asànaa an'dii mpa bàfàman baar anà bàfàndyaar ba ukɔɔn ayöb. »
Umwɛy uboo a alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn, kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, akatɛɛnà ngye abwɛy, ngye bi akatoo sye! »
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: « Ngyɛb akà bɛ sye, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn! Ntɔn bɛ làfàtɔɔl buur a mpay musɛn akà baar, wɛɛ bɛ la làfàba anki akà u làpin làmwɛy.
Ngyɛb akà bɛ, ntɔn bɛ làfàtɔŋ an'dii a aŋangɔɔm bàdwä bàtaaràbɛ!
Abun iswaŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa bɛ lan'kyey ndaa bàkyer bàtaaràbɛ: ba bàdwä aŋangɔɔm, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làtɔŋà an'dii aba!
Lalan Nzam kàtɛn nde unsà an'yweerà ande naa: "mɛ ba in'satööm aŋangɔɔm anà antööm, ba bàsàdwa bumwɛy anà bàsàmɛɛy bumwɛy nkwaaŋ."
Lalan an'kil a aŋangɔɔm màpää fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn bàsàtälà udu a un'tswe a baar a mpalàyi,
sɛmà an'kil a Abɛl tii an'kil a Zakàlye awà bàdwä uboboo a mɛsà a ibɔɔn anà idwà. Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, buur a an'kil a baar abà banswà bàsàtälà udu a un'tswe a baar a mpalàyi!
« Ngyɛb akà bɛ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn, bɛ làkyàduum nsab ufàduub ndaa a un'yɛnà. Bɛ ŋakwo làfàbilà anki, bɛ sye làfàtsuŋ baar bumwɛy bàfàkwen mubilà kwo. »
Yàmɛnà naa umpal kàtoo Yɛsu u ndwà, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi bàkun'nüün ntɔn mukun'fuul ndaa yà ifà ifà:
ba bàkäl mukun'lwab ndaa, ntɔn ba bàwɛl ndaa ayifà u mun ande ntɔn ba bun'füün.
